headline: Prototype wave 1 is complete: U-009, U-025, U-026 and U-117 are in main, and U-011, the catalog pattern-setter, is in integration waiting for the next promotion. Promotions now go through a promote/<date> branch. The Prototype forecast is Nov 6 (P90 Nov 10).

phases.name: Build
phases.note: U-118 done Oct 21 (2 days against 3); agent auto-merge is on. Next: the architecture guardrails, then U-001

actionsForDave.title: Promote U-011 to main
actionsForDave.detail: Sync PR 190 is merged. After tonight's nightly smoke passes on integration, open the promotion from a promote/2026-10-25 branch (body in drafts/promotion-2026-10-25.md) and merge it with --merge --admin. Seven units (U-010, U-012, U-018, U-019, U-037, U-091, U-111) wait on U-011 being in main.

heldUp.what: Real-job only: legal review, sponsor terms, Stripe review
heldUp.waitingOn: Client facts with no one to ask in this demo; logged, not blocking

decisionsMade.what: Promotions open from a promote/<date> branch cut from integration, so merging one no longer deletes integration
U-011 pattern note approved with all eight PM recommendations (guest reads take no caller, uuid in addresses, slug history for all four kinds, tiers 24 h, 48 h, 7 days)
Architecture rules: B6 exempts guest-visible reads from the caller check; B7 allows an export ahead of its first caller when a TODO names that unit
architecture-audit becomes a required check on main and integration, beside the other three agent checks
Project status, decisions, delta log, and this roadmap move to their own repo, ramble-pm, published without PRs; unit status and actuals move to the board
U-003 pattern note set: one database folder, a pooled handle for transactions and a read-only one, committed migrations checked in CI, production migrated only with your approval
Vercel Web Analytics and Speed Insights added as U-119 (half a day, agent-built), guest pages only, never checkout
Vercel connected to GitHub: a preview for every push; production builds from main are staged until you promote them
Approval window is on. App stack for U-001: pnpm, React Compiler on, strict type-checked lint
You approve the first agent PRs yourself (rulesets require 1 approval) until you say automated checks alone may merge
Agent auto-merge switched on: standard-tier units merge to main and critical-tier units to integration when every check passes
Merge desk merged (PRs 134 to 136) and dry run passed (PRs 137 to 140); agent prompts relaxed for the merge desk scripts only
Ramble gets its own architecture rules; U-001 adds an import-boundary lint so a broken layer rule fails CI
Merge desk files (runbook phase B) written and tested on unit/U-118; a sync PR must add nothing beyond main (a tightening of runbook rule 2)
Start the build now instead of Oct 26, with a push this week; the forecast is refit from today (frozen plan unchanged)
Plan frozen (tag plan-frozen-2026-10-20); repo public with secret scanning; 133 unit issues on the board; merge rules live
Agents get more of the build: they carry half of each unit Dave leads and build the six non-money pattern-setters; Dave keeps holds, payments, and the ledger
December 1 moves: the client sees the Prototype in early December; launch moves to March
The PM set up the project board fields and linked it to the repo
Agents merge their own work in two tiers; Dave reviews money and access code in a weekly batch
A clickable Prototype comes first, then the full build
A merge desk unit (U-118) is added; Dave builds it first
Dave's time is 10 to 15 hours a week
Figma Code Connect stays unpublished (the Figma plan refuses it)
Scope: 116 build units; Stripe estimated but not built; the Shoulds are cut first
Stack: Next.js, Neon Postgres, a fake payment gateway for the demo, Vercel
Look and feel: "Sunday paper"; mobile first
PRD v1.0 signed: 78 requirements, 14 judgment calls

watch.what: Agent speed: wave 1 far ahead of estimates
watch.detail: Four agent units merged in 0.1 to 0.4 estimate-days each against 0.75 to 2 likely, after two to five review rounds. The forecast does not learn from actuals yet, so later agent units may be overestimated too.

watch.what: The money core is the critical path
watch.detail: Holds, then payment intake, then confirming orders, then gifting. A slip there moves launch day for day.

watch.what: Review time is about 68 h, not the 30 h hoped for
watch.detail: People checks, escalations, and the weekly promotion remain under the new merge rule.

scenarioNotes: Current forecast (Oct 21, refit): from Oct 22 with U-118 done; Dave puts in about 20 hours this week, then 12.5 a week. Agents merge their own work, with Dave approving each PR at first.
The same start and progress, with Dave at a steady 12.5 hours a week from today.
